name: gridstatus_datasets
description: List/search US grid datasets (LMP prices, load, fuel mix across the 7 ISOs: CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE). Use this to discover the exact dataset_id to pass to gridstatus_query. Example: gridstatus_datasets({ filter: "caiso lmp", _apiKey: "your-key" })

filter.description: Optional keyword(s) to narrow the list, matched against dataset id/name/description/source (all words must match). E.g. "caiso lmp", "ercot load", "pjm fuel mix". Omit to list all.

_apiKey.description: GridStatus API key (free tier at gridstatus.io)

name: gridstatus_query
description: Query a grid dataset's time-series over a time window. Pass a dataset_id from gridstatus_datasets. Common ids: caiso_lmp_real_time_5_min, ercot_load, pjm_fuel_mix. Example: gridstatus_query({ dataset_id: "caiso_lmp_real_time_5_min", start_time: "2026-07-01T00:00Z", end_time: "2026-07-01T06:00Z", limit: 100, _apiKey: "your-key" })

dataset_id.description: Dataset id to query, e.g. "caiso_lmp_real_time_5_min", "ercot_load", "pjm_fuel_mix". Discover ids via gridstatus_datasets.

start_time.description: Optional ISO start time (rows on/after this). E.g. "2026-07-01T00:00Z" or "2026-07-01T00:00-05:00".

end_time.description: Optional ISO end time (rows before this).

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 50, capped at 200).

resample_frequency.description: Optional resampling bucket, e.g. "5 minutes", "1 hour", "1 day". Reduces row volume for long windows.

name: gridstatus_latest
description: Latest values for a grid dataset — convenience that pulls the most recent rows from a recent window. Pass a dataset_id (e.g. "ercot_load", "caiso_fuel_mix"). Example: gridstatus_latest({ dataset_id: "ercot_load", _apiKey: "your-key" })

dataset_id.description: Dataset id, e.g. "ercot_load", "caiso_lmp_real_time_5_min", "pjm_fuel_mix". Discover ids via gridstatus_datasets.
